sqlMap.select:
SELECT DISTINCT PH.PHYIKY AS VALUE_COL , '' AS TEXT_COL FROM PHYDH PH INNER JOIN PHYDI PI ON PH.PHYIKY = PI.PHYIKY WHERE WAREKY = #SES_WAREKY#
AND DOCDAT = REPLACE(#DOCDAT#,'.','')
AND (PI.QTSIWH != PI.QTYPDA OR PI.REFCAT = ' ')

SELECT PI.PHYIKY , PH.WAREKY , PI.OWNRKY , PI.LOCAKY , PI.SKUKEY , PI.DESC01
, SM.SKUG05 , SM.EANCOD , SM.DUOMKY AS UOMKEY , NVL(MI.QTPUOM,0) AS QTIPSU , PI.QTYPDA AS QTYPDA , PI.LOTA13 , PI.LOTA11 FROM PHYDI PI INNER JOIN PHYDH PH ON PH.PHYIKY = PI.PHYIKY INNER JOIN SKUMA SM ON SM.OWNRKY = PI.OWNRKY AND SM.SKUKEY = PI.SKUKEY INNER JOIN SKUWC SW ON SW.WAREKY = PH.WAREKY AND SW.OWNRKY = PI.OWNRKY AND SW.SKUKEY = PI.SKUKEY LEFT OUTER JOIN MEASI MI ON MI.WAREKY = PH.WAREKY AND MI.MEASKY = SW.MEASKY AND MI.UOMKEY = 'BOX' WHERE 1 = 1 AND PI.PHYIIT = (SELECT MAX(SX.PHYIIT) FROM PHYDI SX WHERE SX.PHYIKY = PI.PHYIKY AND SX.PHYIIT LIKE SUBSTR(PI.PHYIIT,1,4)||'%')
AND PH.DOCDAT = #DOCDAT#
AND PH.PHYIKY = #PHYIKY#
AND PI.LOCAKY = #LOCAKY#
AND PI.REFCAT = ' '
AND PI.QTSIWH != PI.QTYPDA
ORDER BY PI.LOCAKY

SELECT PI.PHYIKY , PI.PHYIIT , PH.WAREKY , PI.OWNRKY , PI.LOCAKY , PI.SKUKEY , PI.DESC01 , PI.QTSIWH , PI.QTSIWH-GREATEST(PI.QTSALO, PI.QTSPMO) - PI.QTSPMO AS USEQTY , PI.QTSALO , SM.SKUG05 , SM.DUOMKY AS UOMKEY , NVL(MI.QTPUOM,0) AS QTIPSU , 0 AS QTYPDA , PI.LOTA13 FROM PHYDI PI INNER JOIN PHYDH PH ON PH.PHYIKY = PI.PHYIKY INNER JOIN SKUMA SM ON SM.OWNRKY = PI.OWNRKY AND SM.SKUKEY = PI.SKUKEY INNER JOIN SKUWC SW ON SW.WAREKY = PH.WAREKY AND SW.OWNRKY = PI.OWNRKY AND SW.SKUKEY = PI.SKUKEY LEFT OUTER JOIN MEASI MI ON MI.WAREKY = PH.WAREKY AND MI.MEASKY = SW.MEASKY AND MI.UOMKEY = 'BOX' WHERE 1 = 1 AND PI.PHYIIT = (SELECT MAX(SX.PHYIIT) FROM PHYDI SX WHERE SX.PHYIKY = PI.PHYIKY AND SX.PHYIIT LIKE SUBSTR(PI.PHYIIT,1,4)||'%') AND PI.SKUKEY = #SKUKEY#
AND PH.DOCDAT = #DOCDAT#
AND PH.PHYIKY = #PHYIKY#
AND PI.LOCAKY = #LOCAKY#
AND PI.LOTA13 = #LOTA13#
AND PI.REFCAT = ' '
AND PI.QTSIWH != PI.QTYPDA
sqlMap.update: UPDATE PHYDI SET QTYPDA = #QTYPDA# , REFCAT = 'V' WHERE PHYIKY = #PHYIKY# AND PHYIIT LIKE SUBSTR(#PHYIIT#,1,4) || '%'
sqlMap.select:
SELECT COUNT(1) AS CNT FROM PHYDI PI INNER JOIN PHYDH PH ON PH.PHYIKY = PI.PHYIKY INNER JOIN SKUMA SM ON SM.OWNRKY = PI.OWNRKY AND SM.SKUKEY = PI.SKUKEY WHERE 1 = 1 AND PI.PHYIIT = (SELECT MAX(SX.PHYIIT) FROM PHYDI SX WHERE SX.PHYIKY = PI.PHYIKY AND SX.PHYIIT LIKE SUBSTR(PI.PHYIIT,1,4)||'%') AND PI.SKUKEY = #SKUKEY# AND (PI.SKUKEY = #BARCOD# OR SM.EANCOD = #BARCOD# OR SM.GTINCD = #BARCOD# OR SM.ASKU05 = #BARCOD#)
AND PH.DOCDAT = #DOCDAT#
AND PH.PHYIKY = #PHYIKY#
AND PI.LOCAKY = #LOCAKY#
AND PI.LOTA13 = #LOTA13#
